name: Central bank rate hike / hawkish surprise
description: Policy rate raised or held with hawkish guidance vs expectations.

name: Central bank rate cut / dovish surprise
description: Policy rate cut or held with dovish guidance vs expectations.

name: Inflation above forecast
description: CPI/PCE print above consensus, raises rate-hike odds.

name: Inflation below forecast
description: CPI/PCE print below consensus, raises rate-cut odds.

name: Employment data beats forecast
description: NFP-style employment release beats consensus.

name: Employment data misses forecast
description: NFP-style employment release misses consensus.

name: GDP growth beats forecast
description: GDP print above consensus.

name: GDP growth misses forecast
description: GDP print below consensus.

name: Trade balance improves
description: Trade surplus widens / deficit narrows vs forecast.

name: Trade balance worsens
description: Trade deficit widens / surplus narrows vs forecast.

name: Government/political stability improves
description: Election result, confidence vote, or coalition outcome seen as market-friendly.

name: Government/political instability
description: Election shock, no-confidence vote, government collapse, contested result.

name: Sanctions / trade restriction imposed
description: New sanctions, tariffs, or trade restrictions affecting the currency's economy.

name: Geopolitical conflict escalates
description: War, military conflict, or major diplomatic breakdown involving the country/bloc.

name: Geopolitical conflict de-escalates
description: Ceasefire, peace deal, or diplomatic resolution.

name: Consumer/business confidence rises
description: Consumer or business sentiment survey beats forecast.

name: Consumer/business confidence falls
description: Consumer or business sentiment survey misses forecast.

name: Labor unrest / strikes
description: Significant strike action reported with economic impact.

name: Payments/CBDC infrastructure positive development
description: Central bank digital currency or payments infrastructure news seen as currency-positive.

name: Payments/CBDC infrastructure negative development
description: Payments infrastructure disruption or CBDC news seen as currency-negative.

name: Favourable regulatory/legal change
description: Court ruling or regulatory change seen as supportive of trade/finance.

name: Adverse regulatory/legal change
description: Court ruling or regulatory change seen as a drag on trade/finance.

name: Climate/energy policy currency-positive
description: Climate or energy policy shift favourable to the currency's trade balance (esp. commodity currencies).

name: Climate/energy policy currency-negative
description: Climate or energy policy shift unfavourable to the currency's trade balance.

name: Scheduled high-impact economic calendar event
description: A known future event (budget, CB meeting, scheduled data release) from the economic calendar, not yet occurred. Deliberately excluded from PESTLE_SIGNAL_POLARITY on the FX side so it never auto-scores as bullish/bearish evidence — it's a forward-looking risk-window flag only, shown in the dashboard's Upcoming section. The scheduled UTC time is embedded in the description as a '[SCHEDULED <ISO datetime>]' prefix, parsed by src/calendar_events.py.
